description: The developer's projects: account → projects → apps. Every account has the project «Explorer» (it can be renamed, not deleted) and new apps land there; a developer who never creates another sees nothing new. The FREE quota is the account's: one pool of credits a day, store and files shared by every app of its free projects (making empty apps does not multiply it), and each app may carry a cap of its own inside the pool (set_app_caps). Pro and the quota packs are the PROJECT's (neblla_billing with projectId): a Pro project has its own pool and its apps stop drawing from the account's. Example: the chess spends 1500 credits a day of «Ajedrez»'s Pro and the free pool stays whole for the yoga and the tests. Connections: Stripe (who the apps sell as), Cloudflare (one token for the developer's server boxes, neblla_byos) and the database (where the apps keep their users' data, as neblla_byodb) are set once on the ACCOUNT, which Explorer uses, and a project may put its own and inherit the rest (example: «Ajedrez» sells with another Stripe and keeps the account's Cloudflare). Omit projectId to act on the account's. Actions: "list" (projects, their apps, plan, pool and connections, with where each comes from: project or account); "create" { name }; "rename" { projectId, name }; "delete" { projectId } (empty and not Pro); "move" { appId, projectId, confirm? }: a real move — the quota counts in the new project from now, the data moves when the two use different databases (ALL its users' data: it answers confirmRequired with the plan first; call again with confirm: true once the developer agreed), its server box redeploys on the new Cloudflare, its media follow; an app that sells cannot move to a project with another Stripe (what is sold stays tied to the account it was sold on). Pro stays with its project. "set_app_caps" { appId, credits?, store? (bytes), files? }: the app's own caps inside its pool; null or 0 removes one. "connect_cloudflare" { projectId?, accountId, apiToken } / "remove_cloudflare" { projectId? }: the token is checked on that account (Workers Scripts: Edit) and sealed; the boxes already running follow it. "connect_db" { projectId?, engine, config, migrate? } / "remove_db" { projectId? }: validated now, sealed at rest; with migrate: true each app it reaches starts moving its data there (ALL its users' data: only when the developer asked). Each app keeps its tables under its own prefix, so several apps share one database. "use_own_stripe" { projectId }: the project sells with a payout account of its own; neblla_payments_account with projectId opens its onboarding. "use_account_stripe" { projectId }: back to the account's (refused while its apps sell with the project's).

apiToken.description: connect_cloudflare: the API token (Workers Scripts: Edit)

config.description: connect_db: { uri, dbName? } (mongo), { url, authToken } (turso), { uri } (postgres, mysql)

confirm.description: move: true once the developer agreed to move the app's data

migrate.description: connect_db: start moving the apps' data there now

projectId.description: The project (list gives the ids). Omitted in connect_*/remove_*: the account's.
